$description: Closed vocabulary of motion patterns observed in the source, each with its reduced-motion fallback. The source itself implements NO prefers-reduced-motion handling (grep returns nothing); the fallbacks are design-repo requirements grounded in the source's own mobile/fit behaviour (CLONE_SPEC_A §0.1: on mobile no timeline or 3D plugin is created).

reducedMotionFallbacks.fit-layout: Collapse the pinned section to fit-content height and render every item at its final state with no scrub (the source's own mobile 'is-fit' layout).
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-gradient: Do not create the WebGL scene; paint the static white-to-grey gradient the source uses on mobile.
reducedMotionFallbacks.final-state: Render the element at its end state immediately (no transform, full opacity, final colour).
reducedMotionFallbacks.static-first-frame: Render one static frame of the loop / interaction and never animate it.
reducedMotionFallbacks.instant-toggle: Switch states instantly (no tween); keep the interaction itself.
reducedMotionFallbacks.native-scroll: Keep the horizontal track as plain overflow scrolling without momentum or tweened steps.

pinned-scroll-timeline.description: Sticky track inside a tall section (height N lvh); one scrubbed timeline maps scroll progress to item tweens with overflowStart/overflowEnd = 1 lvh.

webgl-scroll-scene.description: The fixed WebGL backdrop reads the section's scroll progress (background layer wipes, glass triangles, 3D titles, VR sphere).

lines-slide.description: Text split into lines; each line slides 20px on x or y and fades in (scrubbed).

words-rise.description: Words rise from 130% inside line masks, scale 1.05 -> 1, colour #6630ff -> computed colour.

parallax.description: y +n px -> -n px across the scroll range.

chars-in.description: Characters slide in from x 100% (stagger .05, 1.7s custom::out) when the trigger enters; reverses on leave-back.

mask-reveal.description: A 200px soft linear-gradient mask sweeps up as the element crosses 90% of the viewport.

cards-pop.description: Cards y 25% / scale .95 -> 0 / 1, stagger .1, 0.7s, play on enter, reverse on leave-back.

marquee-loop.description: Infinite horizontal loop of the credential line, 30s per cycle.

sticker-curve-path.description: Glass cards travel right-to-left on a cubic Bezier across the pinned range with a small per-card rotation.

hover-image-pop.description: On hover the label lights up and a photo pops at the viewport edge (CSS transform 2s cubic-bezier).

cursor-image-follow.description: Case-study card image follows the cursor and the title words swap on hover.

draggable-swiper.description: Horizontal track dragged with momentum and edge resistance; prev/next buttons step one card (0.7s power2.out).

accordion.description: Answer region max-height transition .27s ease-out; several answers may stay open.

music-string.description: Divider lines bend toward the cursor and spring back (elastic.out(1.5, .3)).

cursor-glow.description: A glow follows the cursor inside the footer glass panel.

menu-swing-3d.description: Menu panel and widgets swing in on a 3D Bezier path (2-2.9s custom::out); mobile slides down 0.5s.

loader-mask.description: Purple panel with an elliptical three-layer mask lifts on load (1s power2.in) and frames the menu.

button-hover-sweep.description: A violet dome sweeps up through the button on hover (2.5s custom::out in, 0.4s out); text turns white.

load-intro.description: Header logo / CTA and the hero video ease in over 7s custom::out after load.
